facts.text: I have been experiencing very slow internet speeds lately.
I pay a lot of money for internet every month.
I expect my internet service to be fast and reliable.
I believe it is not my fault if my devices are outdated.
I believe it is not my fault if there is congestion in the network.
I believe my ISP should handle issues like outdated devices and network congestion.
I believe my ISP should provide the speed I am paying for without me having to troubleshoot constantly.
